# Historical baseline — public pricing-page intake

**As of:** 2024-04-23. The connector-authentication check is layered onto the approved public-path checklist; it does not replace or broaden the existing eligibility rules. Each negative fixture below isolates exactly one missing input; all other inputs are present. “Non-admitted” means no workspace admission (some conditions route to assistance/pending; others are ineligible or route out).

## Inputs
- **A** — Account has fewer than 50 seats.
- **B** — Verified Helio admin proof.
- **C** — Simple deployment.
- **D** — Supported first integration can be connected in the first week.
- **E** — Current entitlement state.
- **F** — Supported billing conditions (no manual-billing exception).
- **G** — Definite **Yes** to being able to authenticate the selected connector.

## Regression cases
| Case | A | B | C | D | E | F | G | Expected result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Baseline — all present | Present | Present | Present | Present | Present | Present | Yes | Admitted, subject to unchanged route/refusal rules |
| A absent | **Absent** | Present | Present | Present | Present | Present | Yes | Non-admitted; outside under-50 path |
| B absent | Present | **Absent** | Present | Present | Present | Present | Yes | Non-admitted; unresolved admin proof routes to assistance/pending |
| C absent | Present | Present | **Absent** | Present | Present | Present | Yes | Non-admitted; route out of self-serve |
| D absent | Present | Present | Present | **Absent** | Present | Present | Yes | Non-admitted; route out of self-serve |
| E absent | Present | Present | Present | Present | **Absent** | Present | Yes | Non-admitted; current entitlement requirement not met |
| F absent | Present | Present | Present | Present | Present | **Absent** | Yes | Non-admitted; manual/unsupported billing routes out |
| G absent / not definite Yes | Present | Present | Present | Present | Present | Present | **No or Not sure** | Pending; route to assistance before workspace admission; hold connection prompts |

**Lineage / invariants:** On 2024-04-23, a definite Yes continued through the otherwise unchanged checks; No and Not sure remained pending and routed to assistance before admission. Connector authentication is stored separately from Helio admin proof. Agencies, unresolved ownership, manual billing, imports, migrations, unsupported permissions, and existing route-out conditions remain unchanged. Historical baseline only; not a causal evaluation.
